items.title: Will bulls stay in control during Muhurat trading? Experts decode outlook
items.description: Data shows that the Sensex and Nifty 50 have gained in eight of the 10 Muhurat trading sessions between 2016 and 2025.

items.title: AI slump revives Asia's forgotten stock bets, from China to India
items.description: Democrats' sweep of Congress and the resulting rethink of the AI trade are prompting investors to diversify into out-of-favour markets such as India and China
